panels.title: Pregunta 1: ¿Qué tramo agua-vapor-condensado necesita atención primero?

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -10m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "segment_status" and r._field == "risk_score" and r.impacted_problem == "excessive_water_loss") |> group(columns: ["segment_id", "from_node", "to_node", "status"]) |> last() |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 1)

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -10m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "segment_status") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "segment_id", "from_node", "to_node", "fluid", "tag", "unit", "quality", "status", "impacted_problem"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true) |> unique(column: "segment_id") |> group() |> keep(columns: ["status", "risk_score", "from_node", "to_node", "fluid", "tag", "value", "unit", "quality", "reason", "recommendation_link", "cost_efficiency_impact"]) |> sort(columns: ["risk_score"], desc: true)

panels.title: Ranking de tramos con razón, calidad y acción

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpi" and (r.kpi == "condensado_recuperado" or r.kpi == "agua_por_mwh" or r.kpi == "vapor_por_mwh") and r._field == "value") |> group(columns: ["kpi", "unit"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: ¿La eficiencia del circuito confirma la pérdida?

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpi" and r.kpi == "costo_agua_vapor_condensado" and r._field == "value") |> last()

panels.title: Pregunta 2: ¿La variabilidad de biomasa está golpeando potencia y costo?

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and (r.variable == "HumedadBiomasa" or r.variable == "ConsumoBiomasa" or r.variable == "PotenciaMW") and r._field == "value") |> group(columns: ["variable", "unit"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -12h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "maintenance_recommendation") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.equipment == "SistemaBiomasa") |> keep(columns: ["severity", "probable_cause", "suggested_action", "expected_impact"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 3)

panels.title: Pregunta 3: ¿Hay señal de degradación térmica asociada al agua?

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -10m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "segment_status" and r.impacted_problem == "well_water_thermal_degradation") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "segment_id", "from_node", "to_node", "fluid", "tag", "quality", "status"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true) |> unique(column: "segment_id") |> group() |> keep(columns: ["status", "risk_score", "from_node", "to_node", "fluid", "tag", "value", "quality", "confidence", "reason", "recommendation_cause"]) |> sort(columns: ["risk_score"], desc: true)

panels.title: Señal térmica y confianza de datos
Pregunta 4: ¿Qué conocimiento operacional debe quedar sistematizado?

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -12h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "maintenance_recommendation") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "equipment", "severity", "probable_cause", "suggested_action", "expected_impact", "due_minutes", "ack_status"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 8)

panels.title: Causa -> acción -> impacto: base mínima de conocimiento del turno
Pregunta 5: ¿Operación histórica y energía cuentan la misma historia?

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -2h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpi" and (r.kpi == "energia_generada_mwh_h" or r.kpi == "costo_operacional_estimado" or r.kpi == "energia_por_ton_biomasa") and r._field == "value") |> group(columns: ["kpi", "unit"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -10m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "asset_risk" and r._field == "risk_score") |> group(columns: ["equipment"]) |> last() |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 5)
